name: feature-engineering-builder
description: Implements the slice plan (every slice, or only the items named on loop re-entry): writes production code + tests and runs unit tests / stress fixtures / the oracle / budget checks INLINE per slice. Leaf stage: no crew, no subagent spawning. The ONLY stage that writes production code — but it is DENIED write access to .feature/spec.md, design.md, probe.md, and plan.md, so it cannot tamper with the contract or the oracle to force agreement; it may only append to .feature/status.md.
